Subject: Need help with a anticipatory bail case

Hello, my name is Deepak Iyer. I am a 30-year-old civil engineer living in Warangal. Farhan Gill has filed a police complaint against me over ₹17,70,000, and the complaint turns a business disagreement into a criminal case. Can your firm advise me on what to do next? You can call me on +91 64693 07638 or email deepak.iyer@example.in.
